title: Unforgettable!!
text: Charles was a Spectacular Guide! Very knowledgeable/professional is extremely attentive and kind. Polyglot! Sagrada Familia and Casa Batlló were THE CROWN JEWELS!!!
author: claudiapO8235PI

title: An AMAZING experience!
text: Charlie was amazing!!! He was recommended to my husband and I by my father who also toured with Charlie. He was courteous, friendly, enthusiastic, and made us feel like we were family from the very beginning. Charlie catered our tour to our interests and was incredibly informative. We were able to promptly see all attractions in an efficient and knowledgeable way. Charlie was awesome and truly made our Barcelona trip impossible to forget!!!! We couldn’t recommend him more.
author: alexaaU4699GF

title: spectacular
text: Spectacular guide. Charlie is not only a crack and a great person, he made us a supertour telling absolutely everything, he knows the details of everything. Difficult that there is a better one in Barcelona, I recommend it 1000%!
author: hristopau
